steps: 1. Host a bot-filled Adventure mission and enable **Bot Takeover**.
2. Confirm a native bot drives your own hero while you observe. Turn Bot Takeover off and confirm control returns cleanly; this is not an arbitrary-bot selection feature.
3. Enable **AFK Bot Takeover**, wait without input for takeover, then use input to reclaim control. Repeat once.
4. Repeat the handoff in Chaos Wastes and one Weave if available. Record any unavailable mechanism as untested, not passed.
5. Run `/gt_regression_test`, exit normally, and attach the newest log.
assertions: Exactly one temporary bot drives the affected hero, the human identity/party slot remains, and reclaim removes only the temporary bot and restores human control. No slot, despawn, or POSITION_LOOKUP error occurs. Client verification remains a later stage after this solo boundary.
Assert mod._gt_ai_takeover_disabled == false, toggle ai_takeover_enabled, assert a bot player controls the hero unit and party slot unchanged; toggle off restores human control.
